notes.title: SynCo 2321 Dev log & release update
notes.notes:
SynCo 2321 Dev log & release information.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/8be85c72921085e6627b391461c65ac7764ee590.png

The official release of SynCo 2321 is growing closer and I wanted to share the news! A firm date is not yet established but should be within the next two weeks.

"Why hasn't SynCo 2321 already been released?"

When SynCo 2321 was added to Steam I wanted to make sure all of the steps required to launch on the platform were completed. This was accomplished but as a requirement Steam asks for a launch date.  While it would be possible to have released the base game at the date selected, it was more important to me that the game have an increased level of content before offering the game to players. As a gamer myself I felt it was important to meet a certain level of playability before opening the development process up by beginning Early Access. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/0ccfe11f63fac66fc72e5bf2d9acc6ee0b072d33.png
SynCo 2321 version 0.42 dev log

It has been a while since an update has been added to Steam for testing.  SynCo 2321 has been going through the ringer to ensure optimization goals are being met. Additional story content has been added but is currently limited to one possible outcome. It is important to note that the story implemented in the game is in draft form and subject to revision.

Rendering optimization of 3d models to improve gameplay stability.

Chapter 1 Act 1 - basic story arc drafted(playable but without meaningful choice options implemented.)
Chapter 1 Act 2 - Kira plot line 70% completed. No love for Russell at this time.
Reduced AI difficulty for Chapter 1 mobs for testing.
Updated 25% of map to improve character motion and interaction with environment.
Introduced new AI mechanics to be used for boss encounter (not accessible to players in 0.42)
Minor bug fixes.

notes.title: SynCo 2321 version 0.34 developers log
notes.notes:
SynCo 2321
Version 0.34 development log
Expected release to Early Access: Feb 23rd 2022

Fixed quest/dialogue UI to correct display layering issue.

Dropped loot like ammo and med packs will now be automatically collected when a player touches it.

Removed debugging text from scene load.

Kira NPC given initial encounter setup. (Known issue - reentering the area before clearing the last portion of the conversation will lock the conversation up.)

Fixed First Aid Kit identification.

Removed character during Chip's dialogue to prevent potential complications with zed interference.

notes.title: SynCo 2321 version 0.33 developers log
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865497/def5187f0eef47fed93a60091dd81944a30ffb26.png

Expected release to Early Access: Feb 23rd 2022

Added initial quest to explore and tied it into the follow up.

Removed backpack and bedroll from character start. Backpack/bedroll now appear during supply collection quests.

New quest addition to continue storyline. no spoilers.

Adjustments to zombies for balancing. mostly just took away their food supply which made them a tad bit more ornery. 

Setup new NPC core structure

General adjustments to the map , navmesh and light map

Updated grenade UI
